copy.label: UNE MARQUE, UNE DIRECTION.
copy.heading: Des idées dispersées ? Faisons-en une marque.
copy.subheading: Une direction claire. Une marque qui se reconnaît, partout.
copy.body: Un logo d’un côté, un site de l’autre, des contenus qui ne se ressemblent pas ? Magic relie stratégie, identité et création pour construire un univers cohérent. Du premier message aux supports digitaux et aux expériences sur le terrain, chaque élément raconte la même histoire.

concepts.name: Le fil conducteur
concepts.idea: Magic gives scattered brand materials one coherent direction.
concepts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE square 1:1 premium editorial campaign photograph, not a webpage, not a collage, for Magic 360, a playful, bold Tunisian creative agency. This image will fill a large square on the RIGHT of a text-left/image-right website section. Art direction: imaginative physical set design, tactile real materials, convincing photographic lighting, sophisticated editorial advertising, believable perspective and anatomy. Palette anchors: deep forest #102F29, logo green #0B6959, electric pale lime #D8F36A, ivory #F5F8EE; use the additional scene colors stated below. Fill frame with the idea, keep all important objects inside a 6% safe area for rounded corners. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no AI robots, no glowing digital UI, no generic teamwork stock-photo composition. The subject is an illustrative creative concept, not a real agency employee or client. Scene: an airy sky-blue studio cyclorama with soft sunlike shadows. A stylish North African woman in her early thirties, wearing a forest-green work jacket and ivory trousers, stands naturally in a three-quarter full-body portrait. She calmly holds a single long, wide satin LIME ribbon with both hands; the ribbon physically winds in one elegant continuous line between a few suspended tangible objects: a blank poster board, a sculptural packaging carton, a blank closed book, and a simple portrait-format screen with solid abstract color blocks. Every object shares one forest/ivory graphic visual language without any typography. The ribbon is the striking unifying device, not a knot or a tangle. Rich fabric texture, elegant purposeful pose, natural face, sculptural editorial set, slightly low camera viewpoint, crisp medium-format photography. Balanced composition with person central-right and objects arranged around her, spacious blue backdrop. Make it feel like a bold fashion/editorial campaign, not an infographic.
